name: zence
description: Keeps Claude Code inside the correct client, domain, and environment using DataHub's metadata graph.

datahub_url.title: DataHub GMS URL
datahub_url.description: Your DataHub metadata service endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:8080

datahub_token.title: DataHub personal access token
datahub_token.description: Created in DataHub under Settings > Access Tokens. Stored in your system keychain, never written to a file.

mode.title: Enforcement mode
mode.description: audit records without blocking; enforce allows, asks, and denies for real. Start with audit.
